items.title: Pilgrim Drying Herbs
items.alt: A woman in an ochre waistcoat, brown petticoat and linen coif ties a herb bundle to a complete freestanding wooden drying rail.
items.description: A woman in an ochre waistcoat, brown petticoat and linen coif ties a herb bundle to a complete freestanding wooden drying rail. An original historical illustration for personal projects and classroom activities.
